w: During the morning of Yogi Jayanti, 22 youths were intitiated into the holy order by Swamishri. In the evening, during the Yogi Jayanti celebration assembly senior sadhus and Swamishri recalled incidents on the innocence and spirituality of Yogiji Maharaj.

st.t: 109th Birthday Celebration of Yogiji Maharaj 31 May, 2000
w: The 109th birthday celebration of Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj was celebrated with great joy and divinity in Amdavad. Swamishri's morning puja was enriched with devotional bhajans on Lord Swaminarayan and Yogiji Maharaj. After puja, Swamishri paid glowing tributes to the successful efforts of children in their 20-day Deaddiction program by waving a flag and appreciating them on World Anti-Tobacco Day.

At 10.15 am Swamishri arrived for the Diksha ceremony of 22 youths. After the Vedic rituals and mantras Swamishri initiated 4 youths into the sadhu-order and 18 novices into the parshad-order. In his blessings Swamishri explained, " The greatest service in joining the sadhu-fold is that they will inspire faith and satsang in countless people which will liberate them from the cycles of birth and death. The sadhus' noble service to society is their efforts in redeeming people from addictions and vices and inspiring character. We desire that our son becomes a social worker or a national leader or a politician or a doctor or whatever that is a service to society. Likewise becoming a sadhu is the greatest service to society. What greater service is there than to transform all types of people by inspiring character and virtues! People fail to understand this. And this work is being done by the wish of Yogiji Maharaj..."

In the main Yogi Jayanti assembly in the evening the senior sadhus talked glowingly of Yogiji Maharaj's saintliness and purity. Swamishri blessed the 7,000 congregation, saying, " Like a coconut made of sugar, where every part is sweet, Yogiji Maharaj's life was full of sweetness, and glory of God's greatness. He never found fault in anyone but saw divinity and goodness in all. From his young age he was inclined towards service and love. He stayed at the mandir in Dhari to hear discourses, perform arti and puja of Thakorji and clean the mandir. He also meditated by the village river in the morning. One would enjoy being with Swamishri. His love, his natural way of talking would make anyone feel like staying with him. So his sweetness, that is his divinity, would make any person postpone his work and stay to avail of his spirituality and he would return with peace in his llife. Lord Swaminarayan was present in Him..."

In the evening assembly 1,800 kishores and kishoris had gathered for the special function. A drama presentation and interviews called 'Aa to Satyug Vartaay Chhe' depicted the resolve of many youths who have not flinched or relaxed in their morals. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

2006.o: 57 Pramukh Varni Din & Opening of BAPS School, Pardi-Panera
w: At 6.15 pm Swamishri arrived at Pardi-Panera for the opening of Swaminarayan Vidyamandir, a BAPS school. In the first phase the nursery school building was ready for the inauguration ceremony. Swamishri and Shri Dungarshibhai Gala (donor of the land), renowned educationist Shri K.R. Desai, Collector and other dignitaries participated in the opening ceremony. Swamishri and Dungarshibhai declared the school open by untying the nada-chhadi. Swamishri sanctified each and every classroom and blessed the students. A student dressed as a rishi asked Swamishri, “O Gurudev, give us knowledge so that we can progress in life.” Swamishri replied, “The school has been opened and children will be taught brilliantly. You have to learn two types of knowledge – one of this world (apara) and the other of the spiritual world (para). One gets apara knowledge in today’s schools and the school for para vidya is being opened today. “Bhagwan Swaminarayan is God. And God has graced us with this life and parents. He has given us food to eat, water to drink and air (to breathe). He loves us very much. So to love God you should pray to him and serve your parents. Matru devo bhava, Pitru devo bhava, Acharya devo bhava are the main principles of our culture. May you imbibe them in your life. After your daily bath pray to God, bow down to parents and study well.”

Thereafter, Swamishri arrived at the giant gathering of 20,000 devotees. The rains stopped temporarily. Prior to Swamishri’s arrival Viveksagar Swami talked about Swamishri’s glory in celebration of Pramukh Varni Din and about the newly built school complex. Gnanvatsal Swami talked about the Sanstha’s socio-spiritual services and its contribution towards value-based education. Various dignitaries on stage were honoured: Kiranbhai Patel MP, Dolatbhai Desai MLA, District Panchayat President Ganpatbhai, Lakshmanbhai Patel MLA, BJP District President Shri Nalinbhai Patel, Dungarshibhai Gala, Collector Dilipbhai Raval and other officials. Shri Ramsinhbhai Desai, Director of Swaminarayan Vidyamandir, spoke about the school details. He said, “The 35-acre educational complex has been launched with the nursery school in its first phase. Thereafter, the school will have buildings for primary and secondary (Gujarati and English mediums) education. Other extra educational facilities will be provided like a resource centre, arts centre, handicraft, health, hostel, swimming pool, mandir, etc. There will be only 40 students per class so that personal development can be focussed upon.” After the addresses by dignitaries a traditional dance was performed by youths to celebrate Swamishri’s 56th Pramukh Varni Din. Despite the rains 20,000 devotees remained seated in the assembly to listen to Swamishri’s blessings. Swamishri said, “You have all come heartily to celebrate the opening ceremony of the Vidyamandir. Even Varun dev (rain-god) has blessed us today. The school complex has been accomplished by the grace of God, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Today, there is a need for education. We have schools made by the government and social organizations that benefit many. Here, we have a tribal area and decided to build a school so that children can study properly, serve their parents and please God. By acquiring apara vidya a person attains material happiness and in realizing para vidya he becomes happy in the life hereafter. In India these two streams of knowledge have been taught since the Vedic period. Both types of knowledge will be taught here.” The celebration assembly concluded at 8.15 pm.

The installation festival in Limbdi was completed without any obstacle. Thousands of devotees benefited. Even after this festival, Pramukh Swami Maharaj stayed in Limbdi for a few days and met the devotees of the Jhalawad region during the meeting times.
During today's meetings, seeing the devotees of the village of Pandari, Swamishri said, "Where are all the others? Bring all the devotees of the village tomorrow."
The sadhus said, "Here every day there is a great rush and crush of devotees. So it will not be possible to give everyone a personal meeting with you, but two to five leaders can come."
Swamishri said, "Then bring two to five. For two days I have been remembering and wondering why the devotees of Pandari are not to be seen."
The sadhus said, "During the festival they were all busy with seva. The wind up is over, so they have come today."
Swamishri has travelled through village after village. His bond of love with the heart of each and every devotee remains just as unshakeable even today.
Ramji Dada's family came for darshan. At that time too Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "For two or three days I have been remembering them, wondering where all of them are and what they are doing."

Even in the midst of extreme busyness, this affection of Swamishri touches everyone, and because of such affection, the flame of dedication is also kindled in the devotees. Pravinbhai, the son of Haribhai, had his daughter's wedding the very day after the installation, yet Pravinbhai remained busy in the mandir's seva right up to the day of the installation. Only after going home at night did he take up the family work.

The installation festival at Limbdi was completed without any obstacle. Thousands of devotees benefited. Even after this festival, Pramukh Swami Maharaj stayed in Limbdi for a few days and met the devotees of the Zalawad region during meeting times.
During today's meetings, seeing the devotees of the village of Pandri, Swamishri said, "Where are all the others? Bring all the devotees of the village tomorrow."
The sants said, "Here every day there is a great rush and crush of devotees. So it will not be possible to arrange a personal meeting with you for everyone, but two to five leaders can come."
Swamishri said, "At least bring two to five. For two days I have been wondering why the devotees of Pandri are not to be seen."
The sants said, "During the festival they were all doing seva. The wind up is over, so they have come today."
Swamishri has roamed from village to village. His thread of love with the heart of each and every devotee remains just as firmly tied even today.
Ramji Dada's family came for darshan. Then too Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "For two or three days I have been remembering, where could they all be? What could they be doing?"

Even amid great busyness, this affection of Swamishri touches everyone, and because of such affection the flame of dedication is lit in the devotees too. Pravinbhai, son of Haribhai, had his daughter's wedding the very day after the installation, yet Pravinbhai remained busy in the mandir's seva right up to the day of the installation. Only after going home at night did he take up his worldly tasks.

Having darshan in the sanctified rooms of the gurus, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to have darshan of the murtis in the assembly hall. Here, along with the painted images of Shriji Maharaj and Swami, painted images of paramhansas have also been placed below. Pointing to the three paramhansas on the left, Swamishri asked a sadhu standing nearby, "Were there clocks in the time of the paramhansas?" Only then did everyone's attention properly go to the clock with hands painted in that picture. The sadhus guessed and said, "Perhaps there were." Swamishri said no.
How subtle Swamishri's observation and knowledge are!
Today devotees had lovingly offered a meal with ice cream to Thakorji and the sadhus. After the chesta, the sadhus requested, "Swami! Please take a little."
Swamishri said no.
They filled half a spoon. Still no. Then, filling the spoon with just a trace of ice cream, only enough to touch the spoon, they showed it and requested, "At least take this much."
Swamishri said, "It tastes bitter..."
Everyone laughed. The requests were dropped.

But the surprising thing was that two months earlier, on 24 March 2017, while going to bed at night, Swamishri himself had said, "However bitter a medicine is, it does not matter to us; everything tastes the same..." And now ice cream tastes bitter! Is this the only difference between us and the guru? We use tricks to enjoy sense pleasures, and he uses tricks to push sense pleasures away.
